remarks: Shippan Point-Waterfront Community. Facing East on Westcott Cove beach, with some water views and magnificent sunrises. Two bedrooms upper level, on a two family building. Private entrance, huge terrace across from the beach. In move in condition unit, includes hard wood floors in living/eating area and one bedroom, marble floor on primary bedroom; ceiling fans in all rooms, also W/D. Heat, hot water & cooking gas included in the rent. Walk to restaurants, stores, park, public tennis courts and beach. Great neighborhood to ride a bike or go jogging. Easy commuting 6 minutes to RR station & vibrant downtown. Barbecue on your terrace, enjoy friends and family - relax catching the sea breezes from the Sound. Cross the road to West Beach for a stroll on the sand or go for a swim!
